input.summary: Make the 12-month fees cap mutual and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
input.comment: [Playbook] We made the existing twelve-month fees cap mutual (today only TrueLink is capped, leaving Client's liability unlimited) and placed indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. We also replaced the reference to non-existent Sections 3, 4 and 11 with the Agreement as a whole so the clause is workable.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT, WHICH ARE NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
